name: Xavier Ray
life: “I still remember the first time I returned to a pier after losing somebody.” People around the steps at Pier Beach know Xavier by a small Friday habit. Xavier watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I cannot read a sale sign from offshore. I came into the marina for the first time since my dad drowned.
appearance: Xavier has a narrow face with an expressive upper lip. Look for a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a pale blue work shirt with a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve. In conversation Xavier rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Xavier treats keeping somebody waiting as a serious discourtesy. This can turn a helpful person into an impatient one when everybody else needs a slower conversation.
agenda: To go back through the marina gate.
family: Joy Nelson is Xavier’s cousin. Xavier saves a place. Joy chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *A clean coat for court*, Joy says, “I used to run stolen goods with the defendant.”
connections: Eden Fisher. The half-share bidder and the person returning to the gate both ask what entry would really cost.

reactions.response: Xavier checks who owns the name before anyone comes down with a paint tin.

reactions.situation: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs
reactions.response: Xavier stays where both neighbors can hear a familiar voice and gets news from the caretaker.
